text.arabic_uthmani: يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٱلْغَفُورُ

words.gloss_range: ongoing knowing that governs the full chain of entering, exiting, descending, and ascending processes
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, discerning, marking, teaching, and knownness; locally direct discerning knowledge rather than mere seeing or acquired learning
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) opens the ayah as one ongoing act of knowledge stretched across four relative clauses. {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) makes the hidden movements legible as marked and discerned realities, not merely things watched from outside. The surface form keeps the knowing direct and present, and the repeated ya-prefix thread makes the governing verb and the four motion verbs sound like one present-tense chain. The intertextual field with 31:34, 34:3, 34:6, and 57:4 places this inventory inside a larger pattern of unseen and vertical knowledge, while the boundary from 34:1's closing inward-awareness title is enacted as a motion-by-motion survey. Its position before the mercy-forgiveness seal lets total awareness press first, then be ethically reinterpreted by the closing names.

topics.headline: single verb over four clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one present-tense knowing holds all four motion clauses together instead of restarting with each movement.
topics.reason: The grammar makes the first verb govern the coordinated relative-clause series, so the motion inventory remains one field of awareness.

topics.headline: discernment of marked hidden motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hidden entry, exit, descent, and ascent are treated as discernible marked realities, not vague unseen flux.
topics.reason: The root field supports knowing by recognition and marks; local syntax applies that discernment to the following motion clauses.

topics.headline: direct imperfect knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents direct ongoing knowledge, not learned information or a communicated report.
topics.reason: The surface is a finite imperfect of knowing; supplied causative or receptive family forms remain contrastive rather than local senses.

topics.headline: knowledge pattern across nearby and parallel passages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 34:2 joining a Quranic field where unseen knowledge, descent, ascent, and revealed truth are cross-linked, including 31:34, 34:3, 34:6, and 57:4.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah and formulaic references that clarify the local knowledge inventory without replacing it.

topics.headline: opening inventory frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word controls the whole ayah movement: known processes first, identity seal after.
topics.reason: The word begins the verbal survey and is later answered by the nominal attribute clause.

topics.headline: audible and formulaic motion field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated present-tense sound and the descent-ascent knowledge formula make the list cohere as one heard pattern.
topics.reason: The echo rows support both a rare vertical-knowledge formula and the ya-initial verbal thread.

topics.headline: ya-prefix governing chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the governing verb and motion verbs sounding like one present-tense chain.
topics.reason: The phonetic row reinforces, without replacing, the syntactic subordination of the four movements.

topics.headline: 34:1 awareness enacted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 34:2 demonstrating the inward awareness named at the close of 34:1.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects the previous title of inward awareness with this verse's enacted knowledge inventory.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun serving as known object and embedded subject for the first entry clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) leaves the first known item unnamed until the entry verb defines it. Its double role as object of the opening knowledge verb and subject of the entry clause makes the known thing a process rather than a fixed class. Because the form is uninflected, the clause stays open to whatever enters the earth-domain.

topics.headline: object-subject hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same open relative is both what is known and what performs the entry.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence supports the double role under the knowledge verb and inside the first relative clause.

topics.headline: open process class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first object is not narrowed to one entity type; the following motion supplies the boundary.
topics.reason: The semantic rows preserve the openness of the relative pronoun as things, events, substances, or processes.

topics.headline: uninflected openness

topics.reason: The form row confirms that no inflection narrows the first relative head.

topics.headline: first empty slot before motion

topics.reason: The topic follows from word order and the repeated relative-frame architecture.

words.gloss_range: intransitive entry across a threshold into earth as a containing interior
words.root_gloss_range: entering, penetrating, crossing into an inside; locally inward threshold-crossing, not dispute or stubbornness
words.prose: {{ar:يَلِجُ}} ({{tr:yaliju}}) begins the motion list with disappearance into an interior. {{ar:و ل ج}} ({{tr:w-l-j}}) gives the entry a threshold image: something crosses from exposed surface into hidden containment, with the following prepositional phrase making earth the domain entered rather than a direct object acted upon. Form contrasts keep the movement broad and non-causative, while 3:27 and the local exit counterpart show boundary-crossing extended from night-day alternation to earthward concealment. Its compact liquid-to-closed sound also supports the sense of slipping into containment. The ayah therefore begins where ordinary perception loses track.

topics.headline: intransitive entry with containment phrase

topics.reason: The verb is intransitive and completed by the following containment phrase.

topics.headline: threshold into hidden interior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the concrete image of crossing into a concealed interior before any visible emergence is named.
topics.reason: The root rows support entry, aperture, and threshold imagery, locally applied to earthward motion.

topics.headline: basic entry, not caused or requested entry

topics.reason: Form-family contrasts are useful as limits: causative, reflexive, and requestive forms are not the local surface.

topics.headline: entry logic recast from 3:27

words.gloss_range: preposition marking in-or-into containment for the first motion clause
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns entry into containment. After the entry verb, it lets the earth be read as the place entered and the interior within which the movement is known. Its later answer in the final path phrase helps bracket the four motions with domain language: lower entry opens the frame, upper ascent closes it.

topics.headline: containment bracket begins

words.gloss_range: definite lower domain that receives entry and supplies emergence in the first pair
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, lower realm, broad surface and receiving depth; locally the total lower pole of entry and exit
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is not just soil underfoot. {{ar:أ ر ض}} ({{tr:ʾ-r-ḍ}}) supplies the lower domain as a broad known earth that receives what enters and yields what comes out. The preposition pushes the visible surface into interior depth, while definiteness and singularity keep the lower field unified. In the ayah architecture, earth is the first pole of a vertical map: 34:1 says what is in it belongs to God, 34:2 tracks what moves into and from it, and 34:3 expands the unseen field.

topics.reason: The noun is definite, singular, and genitive after the preposition.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the exit clause under the same knowledge verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second relative clause under the same governing knowledge verb. As a prefixed connector attached directly to the next open relative, it makes the continuation immediate rather than loosely appended. It does not merely add another item; it turns entry into half of a lower-domain pair by placing emergence beside it as an equal component of the inventory.

words.gloss_range: second open relative pronoun for whatever comes out from earth
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) repeats the open relative frame for the exit clause. Its repetition confirms that the ayah is building a patterned inventory.

words.gloss_range: intransitive emergence from earth, with source marked by the following pronoun phrase
words.root_gloss_range: going out, coming forth, emergence, yield, extraction, birth, and outlet; locally broad outward issue from earth without explicit causation
words.prose: {{ar:يَخْرُجُ}} ({{tr:yakhruju}}) answers the inward first motion with outward emergence. {{ar:خ ر ج}} ({{tr:kh-r-j}}) spans coming forth, yield, outlet, extraction, and birth, so the clause can include every kind of earth-output without narrowing to crops or mining. The form stays intransitive: the ayah tracks what comes out, while agency remains implicit. Its rough opening and tight close also reinforce the sense of a break-out from concealment. Paired with the entry verb, this makes earth a boundary crossed in both directions, and provision echoes such as 2:22 and 6:99 are widened into a total survey.

topics.reason: The verb is intransitive and takes the following source phrase.

topics.reason: The root rows support emergence, yield, outlet, extraction, and birth imagery.

topics.reason: The intertext rows give concrete provision parallels and explain the local widening.

topics.reason: The second motion answers the first and prepares the later down/up pair.

topics.headline: outward break texture

topics.reason: The phonetic row is supportive and secondary to grammar and root evidence.

words.gloss_range: source phrase from it, with feminine pronoun returning to earth
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهَا}} ({{tr:minhā}}) closes the earth pair by compressing source and antecedent into one word. The pronoun points back to earth, while the source preposition keeps emergence tied to provenance and, where context allows, partitive extraction from a larger concealed whole. Only after this closure does the inventory pivot upward.

topics.headline: earth antecedent fixed

topics.headline: source and partitive pressure

topics.reason: The semantic rows preserve source as primary while allowing partitive pressure.

topics.headline: compressed source pronoun

topics.reason: The form row explains the fused preposition and pronoun.

topics.headline: lower-domain closure

words.gloss_range: conjunction pivoting from the earth pair to the sky pair under the same governing verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge between domains. It keeps the opening knowledge verb active while moving the inventory from earth entry and exit to sky descent. As a prefixed connector fused to the next relative slot, it keeps that upward pivot visibly inside the same coordinated sequence. The addition is structural, not chronological: the ayah rises to a new domain without starting a separate assertion.

topics.headline: middle domain hinge

topics.reason: The conjunction is positioned between the completed earth pair and the descent clause.

words.gloss_range: third open relative pronoun for whatever descends from sky
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) repeats the object-subject slot for the descent clause. The open form prevents descent from being reduced to rain, revelation, beings, or any single class, while the source phrase supplies the direction. By the third occurrence, the repeated relative frame is unmistakably a fourfold inventory.

topics.headline: third object-subject slot

topics.reason: The third relative is object of the knowledge verb and subject of the descent verb.

topics.headline: open descent object

topics.reason: The semantic rows preserve rain, command, revelation, provision, force, object, or event as possible classes.

topics.headline: classless third relative

topics.reason: The form row keeps the descending class unrestricted.

topics.headline: fourfold refrain confirmed

topics.reason: The third occurrence confirms the patterned relative sequence.

words.gloss_range: intransitive descent from the sky-source, with variants exposing causative sending-down pressure
words.root_gloss_range: descending, alighting, lodging, arriving, sending down, and revelation; locally broad downward motion from sky with agency implicit in the base reading
words.prose: {{ar:يَنزِلُ}} ({{tr:yanzilu}}) begins the upper-domain pair with downward motion from the sky-source. {{ar:ن ز ل}} ({{tr:n-z-l}}) keeps descent physically felt through falling and alighting while also open to revelation, command, provision, and staged sending. The base reading leaves agency implicit and keeps the descending class open; variant causative readings expose a sending-down frame without replacing the local broad motion, and the surface form avoids turning descent into requestive drawing-down. Its softer sound then contrasts with the rougher ascent verb while both remain linked by the present-tense frame. Same-surah 34:6 later narrows the root toward revealed truth, while 97:4 and 57:4 help place descent within a wider vertical formula.

topics.headline: intransitive descent with source phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the descending thing remains open while sky is fixed as source.
topics.reason: The base verb is intransitive and takes the following source phrase.

topics.headline: physical descent open to revelation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices downward motion that is concrete but not reducible to weather.
topics.reason: The root rows support physical alighting, rain, lodging, sending down, and revelation range.

topics.headline: base descent and causative variants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two descent frames: base motion with implicit agency and variant sending-down with explicit causation.
topics.reason: The qiraat and form rows change valency and agency pressure while preserving the fourfold architecture.

topics.headline: cosmic descent before revealed descent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 34:2 presenting descent broadly before 34:6 narrows the same root to revealed truth, with 97:4 as a staged-descent contrast.
topics.reason: The intertext rows provide concrete references and keep the local object class open.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking sky as origin of descent
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) makes the sky the source from which descent comes. Its source force contrasts with the final path phrase, so the upper pair is not a simple reversal: descent comes from sky, while ascent occurs in or through it. The vowel before the definite noun preserves this source relation without changing it.

topics.headline: sky as source

topics.reason: The preposition governs the sky noun and marks source.

words.gloss_range: definite upper domain serving first as source of descent and then as path of ascent
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, upper region or canopy, with disputed naming associations kept secondary; locally the concrete sky-domain of source and path
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَآءِ}} ({{tr:al-samāʾi}}) completes the vertical map by introducing the upper pole after the earth pair has closed. {{ar:س م و}} ({{tr:s-m-w}}) gives the noun height and upper-domain force, while the source preposition makes it dependent in the descent clause rather than an actor. Its singular definiteness differs from the plural heavens of 34:1: here the upper realm is a concrete source and path for motion, and the long vowel plus hamza give the upper-domain word audible breadth. Provision parallels such as 2:22 are widened, and the same sky later supports ascent through the final pronoun phrase.

topics.headline: genitive upper source

topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive after the source preposition.

topics.headline: height as structured upper domain

topics.reason: The root rows support elevation, upper canopy, delimited domain, and height preparing ascent.

topics.headline: concrete singular sky

topics.reason: The form rows contrast the local noun with abstract branches and the previous plural heavens.

topics.reason: The intertext rows connect sky with earth, descent, ascent, and provision fields.

topics.reason: The boundary row carries the upper realm from possession language into movement language.

words.gloss_range: final coordinating conjunction adding ascent as the matching upper-domain clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the fourth relative clause under the same knowledge verb. As a prefixed connector bound to the final open relative, it marks ascent as the matched last slot of the inventory. It gives ascent coequal status with descent and completes the upper-domain pair before the ayah turns to identity predicates. Its function as a completing coordinator differs from the next conjunction that opens the attribute seal.

topics.headline: final object coordinated

topics.headline: completion fused to relative

topics.headline: sky pair closed before seal

topics.reason: The conjunction joins descent to ascent and prepares the turn to the nominal seal.

words.gloss_range: fourth open relative pronoun for whatever ascends in or through the sky-domain
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) closes the fourfold relative refrain. It is still both known object and embedded subject, and still refuses to classify what ascends by gender, number, animacy, or category. Because the final open slot stays broad, the ayah can complete the inventory without naming one theological or physical object as exhaustive.

words.gloss_range: routed upward ascent through the sky-domain, not generic rising or caused ascent
words.root_gloss_range: ascending, climbing, mounting by a route, with winding or uneven path imagery; locally marked upward movement through a domain
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْرُجُ}} ({{tr:yaʿruju}}) closes the motion chain with routed ascent. {{ar:ع ر ج}} ({{tr:ʿ-r-j}}) does not give a bare upward arrow; it evokes climbing, route, stairway, and even non-straight movement, so the final motion is knowable as a path through the sky-domain. Form contrasts keep detour and causation secondary, while 70:3 and 57:4 locate the rare root inside a specialized route-and-knowledge field. Its heavier guttural-to-closed sound reinforces the feel of a rough climb. The last motion answers descent and hands the completed inventory to the mercy-forgiveness seal.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ascent completed by a domain phrase, not merely by source or bare direction.
topics.reason: The verb is intransitive and takes the final path-domain phrase.

topics.reason: The form rows narrow supplied family alternatives to the surface Form I ascent.

topics.reason: The intertext rows give concrete references and co-occurrence evidence.

topics.headline: marked path closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices rarity, route semantics, and the path preposition converging to make the last movement precise.
topics.reason: The synthesis row combines root rarity, path semantics, and local grammar.

words.gloss_range: path-domain phrase in it or through it, with feminine suffix returning to sky and pause closing the inventory
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا ۚ}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) fixes the ascent inside or through the sky-domain. The pronoun resumes sky, and the preposition differs from the earlier source marker: descent comes from sky, ascent is traced in or through it. In one compact word, the path preposition and sky-reference stay fused so the final ascent remains both relational and anaphoric. The pause after the phrase lets the four motion clauses settle as complete before the final identity seal begins.

topics.headline: path-domain not source

topics.reason: The phrase uses the domain preposition and resumes the sky antecedent.

topics.headline: within and through senses

topics.reason: The semantic row keeps both within and through active in the local path relation.

topics.headline: fused path pronoun

topics.reason: The form row explains the fused preposition and feminine pronoun.

topics.headline: pause before attributes

topics.reason: The pause and phrase position mark the structural turn to the nominal clause.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the nominal attribute clause after the motion inventory
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) changes function at the seal. Earlier conjunctions accumulated relative clauses, but this one opens a nominal clause with the explicit pronoun, and the connector is bound directly to that pronounced subject. The shift prevents mercy and forgiveness from being read as another item in the inventory; they interpret the whole field of known motion.

topics.headline: resumptive nominal opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final conjunction begins predication, not another motion object.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the pronoun and nominal predicate clause.

topics.headline: continuity with reorientation

topics.reason: The semantic row supports resumptive or circumstantial linking into the attribute seal.

topics.reason: The form row explains the fused conjunction-pronoun opening.

topics.headline: motion inventory to identity seal

topics.reason: The structure rows contrast this final conjunction with the earlier coordinating ones.

topics.headline: same particle builds and closes

topics.reason: The synthesis row accounts for both accumulation and structural turn.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun re-anchoring the divine subject before two definite predicates
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) makes the subject explicit after the long pro-drop verbal survey. The pronoun identifies the knower of every movement as the same one named by mercy and forgiveness, so exhaustive knowledge and compassionate covering are not split between different subjects. Its detached form also changes the syntax from event-report to stable nominal identification, carrying continuity from 34:1 into 34:2.

topics.reason: The independent pronoun stands before two definite predicates.

topics.reason: The form row explains the detached pronoun's fresh grammatical anchor.

topics.headline: verbal survey to nominal identity

topics.reason: The pronoun begins the nominal clause after the four motions are complete.

topics.reason: The boundary rows trace the same referent from 34:1 into the pro-drop verb and explicit pronoun.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive predicate of enduring mercy that begins the two-name seal after total knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, womb-like protection, kinship, gentle rain, and enduring compassionate care; locally stable merciful identity for the knower
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّحِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-raḥīm}}) begins the attribute seal as a definite predicate, not a modifier. {{ar:ر ح م}} ({{tr:r-ḥ-m}}) gives mercy protective and sheltering force, with gentle-rain and womb-kinship imagery turning total knowledge toward care rather than exposure. The form selects enduring mercy in close predicate position, paired with the following forgiveness name, and the paired long-vowel cadence audibly binds the two names as one closing answer. Echoes such as 41:2 and the strong mercy-forgiveness field show a familiar formula specialized here as the answer to the four-part knowledge inventory.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mercy stated as stable identity of the knower, not a temporary reaction or adjective.
topics.reason: The word is a definite nominative predicate after the explicit pronoun.

topics.reason: The form rows contrast broader mercy-name fields and support the intensive pattern.

topics.headline: mercy formula shifted to closing interpretation

topics.reason: The intertext rows provide 41:2 and co-occurrence links with knowledge and forgiveness.

topics.reason: The structure rows place the name after the four motions and at the start of the generalizing tail.

topics.headline: mercy paired with forgiveness

topics.reason: The echo rows support the recurring mercy-forgiveness pair specialized locally.

topics.headline: paired long-vowel cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two names audibly bound as the closing answer to the motion rhythm.
topics.reason: The phonetic row supports the semantic pairing without creating a new lexical claim.

topics.headline: knowledge reframed relationally
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 34:2 not abandoning knowledge but interpreting it through relational mercy and pardon.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects cognitive governance with the mercy-forgiveness seal.

words.gloss_range: second definite intensive predicate of abundant covering-forgiveness that closes the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: forgiving, covering, concealing, shielding, protective layers, and abundant pardon; locally protective covering after total disclosure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafūr}}) completes the nominal seal as a second definite predicate, coequal with mercy rather than a decorative modifier. {{ar:غ ف ر}} ({{tr:gh-f-r}}) turns forgiveness into protective covering: helmet, underlayer, concealment, and pardon answer the pressure of total knowledge. The form marks abundant stable forgiveness rather than one act, and its final position gives the ayah an exposure-to-covering frame; the long rounded final sound gives that covering-forgiveness a full closure. References such as 40:3, 34:4, and 34:15 sharpen the same-root and form contrast while the local pair with mercy makes the knowledge inventory ethically relational.

topics.reason: The word stands as the second definite predicate after the pronoun.

topics.reason: The form rows contrast act-focused and repeated-action family forms with the local intensive name.

topics.reason: The intertext rows provide concrete references for form contrast and same-surah continuity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The governing يعلم opens four ما-clauses paired as يلج/يخرج at الأرض and ينزل/يعرج at السماء.
baseline_models.mechanism: Opposed imperfect verbs organize knowledge around continuous boundary crossings: inward and outward below, downward and upward above. The object of knowledge is therefore dynamic traffic as well as entities.

activation_trace.role: Knowing as disclosure supplies the governing awareness under which every crossing is manifest.
Entry into another's interior supplies the inward half of the terrestrial pair.
Passage to the outside supplies the outward half of the terrestrial pair.
Descent and arrival supply the downward heavenly channel.
Rising upward supplies the reciprocal heavenly channel.

changed_reading.before: He knows all things in heaven and earth.
changed_reading.after: He knows every ongoing crossing of the earth and sky boundaries, including what is still in transit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four traffic clauses close with وهو الرحيم الغفور rather than with a bare knowledge formula.
baseline_models.mechanism: Mercy and protective forgiveness qualify exhaustive knowledge: nothing is missed, yet complete exposure is framed by care and shielding from consequences rather than by surveillance alone.

activation_trace.role: Full disclosure supplies the potentially exposing side of the mechanism.
Tender mercy turns comprehensive awareness toward beneficent care.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer supplies a protective outcome for what knowledge exposes.

changed_reading.before: Merciful and Forgiving are detachable epithets after a statement of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The knower of every exposed passage is simultaneously the one who treats the known with mercy and protective forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fourfold traffic becomes an exact account: even a dispersed minute particle cannot pass out of awareness, its case is established in a record, and that precision serves recompense. Forgiveness is therefore not divine oversight but a known and purposive response.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the model in the focus assertion of knowledge.
Distance, absence, and escape are explicitly denied, closing any route out of awareness.
Minute size and dispersal stress that even scattered micro-traffic remains tracked.
Written establishment that entails judgment converts observation into an accountable record.
Matching action with recompense supplies the record's ethical function.

structural_cues: 34:3 repeats heavens and earth, spans smaller and larger, and ends with a clear book.
The purpose clause at 34:4 immediately directs exhaustive knowledge toward recompense, forgiveness, and provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-escape, dispersed minuteness, established writing, and recompense; I infer an arrow from tracked crossings to exact moral accounting. A live alternative is that 34:3 only intensifies omniscience without making the four focus verbs ledger-like.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts broad cosmic awareness.
changed_reading.after: Every crossing, down to dispersed particulate movement, enters a precise account from which just recompense and informed forgiveness proceed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's descending channel acquires semantic cargo: what is sent down can be knowledge-bearing truth that enters a human recipient and redirects movement onto a path.

activation_trace.role: Literal descent anchors the changed reading in what descends from the sky.
Sending something down and delivering it supplies revelation as the cargo of descent.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the delivered content's downstream effect.

structural_cues: 34:6 identifies what was sent down as truth and coordinates it with guidance to a path.
The recipients are those given knowledge, linking descent to human recognition rather than only to weather.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending down, truth, knowledge, and guidance; I infer a channel from heavenly delivery to human orientation. The alternative is to keep 34:2's descent materially general and treat revelation as only one later instance.

changed_reading.before: What descends from the sky is an unspecified physical flow.
changed_reading.after: The downward flow also includes truth-bearing communication whose arrival produces knowledge and guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth and sky are not passive containers. Torn bodies can be re-created after terrestrial dispersal, earth can engulf, and detached sky matter can be made to fall; the paired channels are sovereign, reversible, and potentially catastrophic.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior anchors engulfment and burial in the focus's inward channel.
Passage outward anchors renewed emergence from terrestrial dispersal.
Descent anchors the threatening inversion in which sky matter falls.
Tearing into separated pieces supplies the body's extreme dispersed condition.
Bringing creation into existence supplies emergence beyond fragmentation.
Earth's sinking or engulfing activates the terrestrial inward channel as judgment.
Downward falling activates the heavenly channel as imposed motion.
A detached piece of sky specifies the threatening cargo of descent.

structural_cues: 34:7 juxtaposes total bodily tearing with new creation.
34:9 offers paired threats from the same earth/sky frame used by the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fragmentation, new creation, engulfment, and falling sky pieces; I infer burial-to-emergence and sky-to-earth reversal as realizations of the focus channels. The alternative is to restrict the focus to ordinary natural traffic and treat these as separate power signs.

changed_reading.before: The four movements describe a stable cosmic circulation.
changed_reading.after: They are reversible sovereign boundaries through which life can be dispersed and restored, or protection can turn into engulfment and impact.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet directly reactivates the focus inventory's earth/termite branch. Hidden creeping penetrates and consumes a load-bearing staff; the delayed outward collapse then discloses that the jinn did not know the unseen. Divine knowledge includes subvisible ingress, internal attrition, and the eventual visible consequence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the contrast between divine knowing and creatures' failed knowledge of the hidden.
The packet's termite image lies latent in the focus word for earth and supplies the surprising lexical hinge.
Hidden creeping supplies the nearly imperceptible initiating process.
The creature of earth explicitly activates the focus inventory's wood-eating termite image.
Internal consumption and corrosion supply the gradual loss of support.
Noisy unstable falling supplies the delayed external result of hidden ingress.
Manifestation after concealment turns material collapse into epistemic disclosure.

structural_cues: 34:14 sequences death, an unnoticed earth-creature, eating, collapse, disclosure, and the jinn's ignorance of the unseen.
The staff remains apparently stable while its interior support is being consumed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden creeping, the earth/termite branch, consumption, collapse, and disclosure; I infer a causal arrow from unnoticed penetration to delayed visible failure. The live alternative is that the earth label is merely taxonomic and the focus's ingress/egress pair should not be extended into the staff.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge covers large, readily named movements between cosmic regions.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge also follows minute hidden penetration inside matter and already comprehends the collapse that will eventually make that process visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descent, terrestrial reception, vegetal emergence, and consumption form a provision circuit. Gratitude is imaged by fresh growth showing outward, while a retaining structure's failed or released flood reverses the circuit and substitutes degraded produce.

activation_trace.role: Descent anchors the incoming water side of the ecological circuit.
Emergence anchors growth and yield coming outward from earth.
Rain descending as provision links heavenly input to edible yield.
Fresh shoots coming out make gratitude materially legible as fruitful emergence.
A retaining embankment supplies regulation of the descending and flowing medium.
One yield replacing another supplies the circuit's punitive reversal.

structural_cues: 34:15 places two gardens, eating, provision, gratitude, a good land, and a forgiving Lord in one scene.
34:16 reverses that scene through a flood and replacement gardens with inferior yield.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, gardens, gratitude, a flood-retaining structure, and substituted produce; I infer the hydrological arrow from descent through soil to growth and food. The alternative is a moral-historical contrast with no need to model the focus verbs as one ecology.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists independent movements known by God.
changed_reading.after: The movements can be read as one regulated ecology in which heavenly input becomes terrestrial fruit, and the same route can be reversed into loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ascent is not an automatically open route. Intercession joins one party to another only by permission, and speech follows the removal of fear from inner hearts; upward communication is licensed and affectively prepared.

activation_trace.role: Rising upward anchors the model in the focus's ascending channel.
Disclosure anchors divine access to the inner states involved in communication.
A mediator joining another supplies the relational traffic seeking access.
Permission supplies the gate condition for that traffic.
Removal of fear supplies the transition that precedes intelligible exchange.
The heart supplies the concealed affective interior known before speech emerges.

structural_cues: 34:23 sequences restricted intercession, permission, fear removed from hearts, and question-and-answer.
The sequence closes with divine height, keeping the communication spatially oriented.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mediation, permission, inner fear, speech, and height; I infer a controlled upward communication channel corresponding to يعرج. A live alternative is that 34:23 describes court protocol without specifying the direction of ascent in 34:2.

changed_reading.before: Whatever ascends does so through an undifferentiated open path.
changed_reading.after: At least one class of upward traffic is permissioned: inner states are settled and access is granted before speech reaches the high court.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inward/outward pair gains an affective and social analogue: remorse is hidden internally, then judgment takes visible bodily form as collars fixed around necks. Knowledge spans the concealed state and its externalized consequence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors knowledge of both hidden motive and manifest result.
Entry into an interior supplies the focus-side analogue for inwardly held remorse.
Bringing a hidden thing out supplies the focus-side analogue for externalization.
Hiding something in the interior specifies remorse's concealed phase.
Grief over what has passed supplies the content held inward.
A collar binding the limb supplies the visible imposed consequence.
The neck locates that consequence on the exterior body.

structural_cues: 34:33 places concealed remorse immediately before visible collars on necks.
The same ayah traces covert night-and-day pressure, hidden response, and public recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed remorse followed by bodily restraint; I infer an inward-to-outward disclosure pattern analogous to يلج/يخرج. The alternative is simple juxtaposition: the chains punish deeds but do not externalize the hidden affect.

changed_reading.before: Entry and exit concern only physical traffic through earth.
changed_reading.after: The pair can also organize divine knowledge of what enters concealment within persons and what judgment later brings into manifest form.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is expanded or narrowed, wealth exits in expenditure, and a successor is supplied in its place. The focus traffic becomes an economy of circulation and replacement rather than a static measure of possession.

activation_trace.role: Outward passage anchors expenditure as a meaningful outflow.
Merciful care anchors the provision cycle as beneficent rather than mechanically compensatory.
Increase and abundance supply the expansion phase of provision.
Narrowing to a small measure supplies the contraction phase.
Wealth leaving through expenditure supplies deliberate human outflow.
One thing succeeding and standing in for another supplies replacement after outflow.
Apportioned giving supplies the source and renewed inflow of the cycle.

structural_cues: 34:36 and 34:39 repeat the same expansion/constriction formula.
34:39 then appends a direct expenditure-to-replacement relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expansion, constriction, expenditure, replacement, and apportioned giving; I infer a circulation arrow from received provision through outflow to renewed provision. The alternative is that replacement is a promise detached from the physical traffic of 34:2.

changed_reading.before: Known inflows and outflows are cosmological facts.
changed_reading.after: They also disclose a provision economy in which possession is temporary flow, generous outflow is known, and replacement remains under divine allocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts truth projected from knowledge of the unseen with humans projecting claims at the unseen from afar. Hidden revelation and near hearing provide the authorized channel; the focus's descent/ascent pair thus acquires an epistemic distinction between delivered signal and remote guess.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure anchors the valid signal in comprehensive divine knowledge.
Delivery downward anchors communicated content entering the world.
Forceful casting supplies truth's directed transmission from the knower of hidden things.
Secret imparting of knowledge specifies the authorized hidden signal.
Understanding and compliance make near hearing the reception side of the signal.
Throwing words supplies the counterfeit human projection toward the unseen from a distance.

structural_cues: 34:48 coordinates casting truth with intensive knowledge of hidden things.
34:50 names revelation, hearing, and nearness; 34:53 repeats casting but marks its source as distant from the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine truth-casting, secret impartation, near hearing, and distant human word-casting; I infer authorized and counterfeit directions within the focus's traffic. The alternative is a rhetorical contrast about truth and false claim with no spatial channel model.

changed_reading.before: Descent and ascent carry unspecified objects.
changed_reading.after: They can carry epistemic signals whose reliability depends on source, authorization, and proximity: revelation arrives from knowledge, while distant guessing only projects at the hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending closes the mobility assumed by the focus: there is no escape, seizure occurs from nearby, reaching from afar fails, and a barrier is inserted. Ingress, egress, and ascent are governed opportunities rather than permanently open routes, giving present forgiveness temporal urgency.

activation_trace.role: An entry place or hidden passage anchors the focus as a system of traversable routes.
Outward passage anchors the possibility that the route of escape can be denied.
Protective forgiveness anchors the still-open present alternative to terminal closure.
Failure of reaching or escaping closes the outward route.
Capture and restraint supply the enforced endpoint of failed escape.
Extending to reach something supplies the access attempt made impossible by distance.
A separating barrier supplies final closure between persons and their desired object.

structural_cues: 34:51-54 moves from no escape, to seizure nearby, to failed reaching from afar, to a barrier between parties and desire.
The sequence is temporal as well as spatial: the attempted belief comes after prior rejection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed escape, capture, inaccessible reaching, and an inserted barrier; I infer that the focus routes are governed apertures that can close. The alternative is to confine closure to the final judgment scene and leave 34:2's movements perpetually descriptive.

changed_reading.before: The cosmic routes appear continuously and neutrally open.
changed_reading.after: Their openness is governed and time-sensitive: the knower can permit passage, deny escape, and finally interpose a barrier, so the title Forgiving names an opportunity not to postpone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split س م و to و س م mapping rather than the ordinary sky branch. It remains anchored in السماء, the focus inventory's sign branch for علم, and the surah's fresh-growth cue; downstream prose should present it only as a packet-licensed resonance, not as a replacement gloss for السماء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يعلم and السماء, read through the supplied mark/sign and rain-marking branches.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides to its object turns knowledge into legible indication.
First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies descent as an inscribing action.
Soft productive earth supplies the receiving surface on which the mark emerges.
Fresh shoots emerging supply the visible trace left by received provision.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge is invisible cognition of rain and growth.
changed_reading.after: What descends can make that knowledge outwardly legible: rain marks receptive earth with emerging vegetation as a sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the packet's س م م target under س م و and its narrow-hole branch. It remains spatially anchored by يلج, السماء, يعرج, and the later permission gate; prose must label it an aperture analogy and must not claim that السماء lexically means a hole here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يلج, السماء, and يعرج together permit a controlled-aperture model of vertical passage.

activation_trace.role: An entry place or narrow refuge supplies the general architecture of passage.
A narrow opening through which something enters supplies the surprising sky-as-aperture image.
Ascent supplies the traffic directed through that imagined aperture.
Permission supplies contextual support for controlled rather than automatic access.

changed_reading.before: Sky is an undifferentiated open expanse through which things move.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sky boundary behaves like a controlled aperture: vertical traffic passes through openings whose access is permissioned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it joins the literal womb branch of رحيم to the earth's ingress and egress. It remains focus-only and visibly anchored in the paired verbs, productive earth, womb, and protective covering; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for hidden formation, not assert that every terrestrial passage is birth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ما يلج في الأرض وما يخرج منها beside الرحيم الغفور.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior supplies reception into a hidden formative space.
Soft productive earth supplies a medium capable of holding and growing what enters.
Emergence to the outside supplies the completion of hidden formation.
The female womb supplies the contained-growth analogy latent in الرحيم's root inventory.
Protective covering supplies the shelter around what forms unseen.

changed_reading.before: Earth merely receives and releases already constituted things.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, earth's inward and outward traffic can resemble gestation: entry is held under covering mercy until hidden formation emerges.

strongest_changes: The four verbs became process knowledge of boundary crossings rather than a static inventory.
34:3-4 turned microscopic traffic into exact, recompense-bearing account without reducing forgiveness to oversight.
34:14 activated the packet's earth/termite branch and exposed a hidden-ingress-to-visible-collapse mechanism.
Provision, revelation, intercession, and final closure showed that the same routes can nourish, communicate, gate, reverse, or close.
summary.what_was_special: The packet produced unusually exact cross-links: أرض's wood-eating termite branch is enacted at 34:14, while split س م و inventories support carefully contained readings of rain as a visible mark and sky as a controlled aperture.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the four movements are a comprehensive merism or four distinct channels with separate mechanics.
How far later communication and judgment sequences may spatialize يعرج rather than merely analogize it.
The split-root marking-rain and aperture readings remain packet-licensed but form-distant and should stay explicitly exploratory.
The gestational model is coherent across focus branches but lacks a direct contextual trigger.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge as supervision of a circulation system.** `و ل ج/B004` is frequent going in and out, `خ ر ج/B001` passing out from within, `ن ز ل/B001` descent, and `ع ر ج/B004` ascent. The grammar repeats `ما` across two opposed vertical pairs. These branches assign each verb a phase in a closed circulation rather than four unrelated objects of knowledge. The packet gives the paired directions; I infer that their symmetry makes one monitored exchange-cycle. The ayah reads as knowledge of traffic and transformation, not merely an inventory of hidden items.
2. **Mercy as protective processing.** `ر ح م/B003` contributes the womb and `غ ف ر/B001` protective covering. Their position after ingress/egress assigns mercy and covering to the environment through which the traffic passes. I infer protection during transformation; the packet supplies only the enclosure-images and sequence. The close thus reads as preservation through passage, not only pardon after wrongdoing.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:10-16 expanded the vertical traffic into air, metal, labor, water, and fruit, while 34:39 made expenditure and replacement another instance of the same circulation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge as monitoring cyclic throughput.** `و ل ج B004` supplies frequent going in and out, not merely a single entry. Four parallel `مَا` clauses alternate ingress, egress, descent, and ascent; 34:3 then denies that even a mote can slip away. The W-L-J branch serves as the cycle's inlet, with the other verbs completing a monitored circuit. The packet supplies the parallel motions and exhaustive accounting; I infer that their arrangement models recurrent throughput. `يَعْلَمُ` therefore reads as process-knowledge of exchanges across a boundary, not only possession of a static inventory.

2. **Forgiveness as an overhead protective envelope.** `غ ف ر B001` supplies protective covering, and `س م و B004` supplies the sky or an overhead cover. The bidirectional movements occur inside an earth-sky enclosure before `ٱلْغَفُورُ` closes the ayah. These branches assign covering the role of a membrane around exposed movement. The packet gives spatial enclosure and the divine epithet; I infer that the cover shelters as well as makes passage knowable. Forgiveness consequently gains a spatial sense of shielding what moves within the ordered system.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:6's second use of N-Z-L, now for what is sent to the messenger, corrected a purely physical reading of descent. The same monitored channel can carry revelation as well as material movement, so the throughput mechanism is informational too.

baseline.text: Yere gireni, oradan çıkanı, gökten ineni ve oraya yükseleni bilir. O, merhametlidir, bağışlayandır.

findings.text: Bilgi, birbirinden kopuk nesnelerin sayımı değil, yer ile gök arasındaki giriş, çıkış, iniş ve yükselişten oluşan tekrarlı bir dolaşımın gözetimidir.
Merhamet ve bağışlama, bu geçişler tamamlandıktan sonra gelen bir sonuçtan çok, dönüşüm sırasında hareket edeni koruyan bir çevre oluşturur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Passage across boundaries and variation across scales do not produce epistemic loss; movement and measure remain held in one intelligible register.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmic direction, subvisible scale, and inscription function as parts of one tracking mechanism rather than as separate proofs of knowledge.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Boundary Transit Without Loss
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Things enter, emerge, descend, and ascend through opposed interfaces while remaining continuously knowable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: interior ingress (`quranic:root_001682:B001/m01`), emergence to the exterior (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`), downward arrival (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`), upward ascent (`quranic:root_000997:B004/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Knowledge is rendered as tracking through interfaces, not merely observation of settled objects. Opposed motions form a single continuous field in which crossing a boundary never becomes disappearance.

channel_generated_outputs.usage: External source manifest only. These generated outputs may inform channel-family/path context when the agent has file access, but first-pass review limits still apply: no established channel name, accept/reject claim, or maturity claim unless a future adjudicated ledger is present.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, bir şeyi bilme ve gerçeğiyle kavramadır; bildirme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında yenme ayrı biçimlere bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bilgisizliğin karşıtı olan temel zihinsel edinimi, tanımayı ve gerçeğe uygun kavrayışı birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun kavrama çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir olay veya gelişme hakkındaki haberin kişinin bilgisine ulaşması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haberin farkına varma ve ondan bilgi edinme yönünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bilginin tekrar ve yönlendirmeyle bir öğrenende yerleşmesini sağlayan öğretim bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin aktarılması ve öğrenende kalıcı bir sonuç oluşturması sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kişi arasındaki bilgi sınamasında bir tarafın ötekini yenmesi bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi alanındaki karşılaştırmayı ve üstün gelme sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bilen ve bildiğine göre davranan kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, haberden haberdar etme, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi yarışında üstün gelme gibi biçime bağlı uzantıları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, anlamları doğrulama, akletme ve çabuk kavrama yönlerini ayrıca öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve zihnen kavrama alanında büyük ölçüde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekleri yakın olsa da odak dalın biçime bağlı aktarım ve edinim süreçleri ile komşunun akletme ve hızlı anlama vurgusu karşılıklı değiştirilebilirliği sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bilginin yokluğu, durumu tanımama veya gerçeğe aykırı bir kanaat bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bilgiye erişmeyi ve kavramayı bildirirken komşu dal bu erişimin bulunmamasını ya da gerçeğin yanlış bilinmesini bildirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda yalın bilme ve tanıma, bilginin doğru kullanımından bağımsız olarak çekirdekte yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal doğruyu bulma, yerinde yargı ve bilgiyi isabetli kullanma niteliğini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bilgi sahibi olmayı ve zihinsel kavrayışı paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bilmek tek başına odak dal için yeterli olabilir; komşu dal ise bilginin doğru yargı ve isabetli davranışla birleşmesini öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bütün işaret türlerini sınırsızca kapsamaz; kaynakta anılan ayırt etme ve yol gösterme işlevli izlerle bunlara bağlı kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

concept_gloss.text: ayırt edici ve yol gösterici işaret
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyi tanınır kılan veya ona ulaşmayı sağlayan belirgin iz ve işaretlerin ortak çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Görünürlük ile yöneltme ve tanıtma işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir savaşçıya, kumaşa veya sarığa başkalarından ayıran görünür bir belirti ekleme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşaretin sonradan konmasını ve ayırt etme amacını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir son zamanın yaklaştığını haber veren gösterge bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Bir olayın yakınlığını gösterme işlevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: savaşta kendine ayırt edici işaret takmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bilerek konan bayrak ve işaretlerin yanı sıra yön bulduran belirgin dağ gibi göstergeleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, geçmişte var olmuş veya gerçekleşmiş bir şeyden geriye kalan izi özellikle gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da görünür bir izin başka bir şeyi tanıtması veya ona kanıt olması bakımından örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda işaret önceden konabilir veya doğal bir kılavuz olabilir; komşu dalda iz, daha önceki bir varlık ya da olayın geride kalan sonucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal doğal dağ işaretini, bayrağı, yol belirtisini ve kumaş kenarını da içine alan daha geniş bir gösterge alanına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle atlara, varlıklara veya nesnelere tanıtma amacıyla işaret koyma eylemini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığı başkalarından ayıracak görünür bir işaretle tanıtmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalın çekirdeği işaretleme eylemine daha sıkı bağlıdır; odak dal ise konmuş işaretlerin yanında doğal kılavuzları ve bayrağı da adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal işaret koyma dışında bayrak, dağ, yol kılavuzu ve kumaş deseni gibi bağımsız adları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, hayvana veya nesneye yakma, kesme ya da benzeri yolla bırakılan bedensel ve maddi damgayı gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal görünür bir belirti aracılığıyla tanıtma ve ayırt etme işlevini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Damga bir yüzeye bilerek bırakılan fiziksel izdir; odak dalın işareti ise doğal veya yapılmış olabilir ve yön gösterme işlevi de taşıyabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: En yararlı karşılaştırmalar geçmişten kalan iz, bilerek konan tanıtıcı işaret ve fiziksel damga ile yapıldı; bayrak adayı yalnızca tek bir alt gerçekleşmeyi, öteki adaylar ise daha uzak renk veya biçim belirtilerini karşılar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلامة والعلم والراية والجبل والمعلم ومعالم الطريق والحدود وعلم الثوب ورقمه وتعليم الفارس والثوب والقدح والعمامة والحناء إذا جعلت علامة

branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل صحيح واحد يدل على أثر بالشيء يتميز به عن غيره (maqayis)؛ العلامة وهي معروفة (maqayis)؛ العلم الراية والجمع أعلام (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلم الجبل الطويل والجميع الأعلام (ayn)؛ العلم الجبل (sihah;mufradat)؛ المعلم الأثر يستدل به على الطريق (sihah;tahdhib)؛ علم الثوب ورقمه في أطرافه (sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ أعلم الفارس إذا كانت له علامة في الحرب (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib)؛ العلام الحناء (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ علمت عمتي أعلمها علما (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı yaratılmışların bütünü, gök düzeni ve içindekiler ya da yaratıkların ayrı sınıfları olarak açıklar. Her sınıfın ve bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması adlandırmanın gerekçesidir; bilme eylemi veya somut işaret dalıyla özdeş değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yaratılmış varlıkların bütünü veya sınıflarıyla sınırlıdır; bilme durumu ve bağımsız bir fiziksel işaret anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak dalın evren, yaratılmışların bütünü ve varlık sınıfları anlamlarını verir; başka kuruluşlardan anlam aktarmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yaratılmış olanların bütünü; bağlama göre evren ile içindekilerin tamamı veya yaratıkların ayrı ayrı sınıflarıdır. Bu bütünün yaratıcıyı gösteren bir belirti sayılması, adın açıklanan dayanağıdır.

facets.statement: Evren ve içindeki yaratılmış varlıkların tamamı tek bir bütün olarak adlandırılır.
Ad, yaratılmışların tamamı yanında onların her bir cinsini veya sınıfını ayrı bir bütün olarak da gösterebilir.
Yaratılmış bütünün kendi yaratıcısına gösterge olması, adlandırmanın açıklayıcı dayanağı olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu adı yaratılmışların bütünü için kullanır; kapsam bazen evren ve içindekilerin tamamı, bazen de yaratıkların her bir cinsi veya sınıfıdır. Bütünün kendi yaratıcısına işaret etmesi adlandırmayı açıklayan ortak bir düşüncedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaratılmış varlıkların tümünü tek bir düzen veya bütün olarak anlatan temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Evreni ve onun içindeki yaratılmışların bütününü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün bütün evren yerine insan, görünmeyen varlıklar veya başka bir yaratık cinsi gibi ayrı sınıflara dağıtıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Her yaratık cinsinin ayrı bir bütün sayılması yönünü korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların çoğu hayvan bedenindeki renk ve işaretleri ya da ilgisiz özel adları anlatır; aynı kökün bilme ve işaret dalları adlandırma gerekçesini açıklasa da bu dalın yaratılmışlar bütünü sınırını keskinleştirecek bir karşıtlık oluşturmaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı açıkça üst dudaktaki yarıkla sınırlar; insanın üst dudağının yarılmış olması, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki aynı belirti ve üst dudağı yarma eylemi bu kimliği doğrular. Genel yarılma anlamı veya alt dudaktaki bir biçim bozukluğu bu dala dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirti özellikle üst dudakta bulunur; genel çatlaklar, alt dudak ve ağız çevresindeki başka eğrilikler kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Üst dudak yarığı dalın temelidir; yarıklı kişi veya deve nitelemesi ile üst dudağı yarma eylemi ilgili biçimlere bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanın üst dudağında veya devenin üst dudak bölgesinde bulunan belirgin yarıktır. Aynı dal, bu özelliği taşıyanı niteleyen biçimi ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Üst dudakta bulunan yarık, dalın anatomik çekirdeğini oluşturur.
Üst dudağı yarık insan veya üst dudak bölgesinde bu belirti bulunan deve, özelliği taşıyan varlık olarak nitelenir.
Birinin üst dudağını yarmak, anatomik sonucun oluşturulmasını bildiren eylemsel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yarığın yerini üst dudak olarak ortak biçimde sınırlar ve yarıklı insanı bu özellikle niteler. Toplu tanıklık, devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki karşılığını ve üst dudağı yarma eylemini de aynı dalda gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya devenin üst dudak bölgesindeki belirgin yarığı adlandıran temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yarığın türünü ve özellikle üst dudaktaki yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanı veya deveyi üst dudak bölgesindeki yarıkla niteleyen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Özelliğin taşıyıcıda bulunmasını ve anatomik yerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin üst dudağında yarık oluşturma eylemini anlatan kuruluşta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemi, etkilenen kişiyi ve üst dudak sınırını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üst dudağı yarık kişi veya deve

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nesne, deri, toprak, dağ ve başka yüzeylerdeki genel yarılma ve açılma sürecini kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deniz ile suyu bol kuyu tek bir ara nesnede birleştirilmez; bunlar aynı biçimin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı sözlük karşılığıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak sözlük biçiminin deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını ayrı ayrı korur; bunlardan genel bir su birikintisi anlamı türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözlük biçiminin bir kullanımda denizi, başka bir kullanımda ise suyu bol kuyuyu adlandırmasıdır. İki karşılık, genel bir su birikintisi anlamında kaynaştırılmaz.

facets.statement: Dal, aynı adın iki ayrı su varlığına verilen sözlük karşılıklarını birlikte kaydeder.
Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık iki karşılığı yan yana verir: bir aktarım sözcüğü deniz olarak açıklar, öteki tanıklıklar ise suyu bol kuyu anlamını destekler. Kaynaklara özgü ayrı claim kimlikleri bulunmadığı için bu karşıtlık ortak özet içinde, atıf uydurulmadan korunur.

concept_gloss.text: deniz ya da suyu bol kuyu

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal deniz yanında büyük ırmak ve farklı büyüklükte su alanlarına uzanan genel bir geniş su kapsamına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Odak dalın deniz karşılığı, komşu dalın geniş ve çok su çekirdeğiyle örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnızca deniz karşılığındadır; odak dalın kuyu seçeneği komşuda bulunmaz, komşunun büyük ırmak ve genel su genişliği ise odak dalın tanımına girmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kuyunun kendisini suyunun bol olması koşuluyla adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuyudaki kovadan dökülen veya havuza taşan suyu, kokusunu ve taşma olayını anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temel adı doğan veya atmaca türünden yırtıcı kuş için verir ve geçici dal görüntüsünü doğrular. Çevik ve zeki erkek nitelemesi ise kuş adından türetilmiş ayrı bir biçimdir; kuşun tanımına doğrudan katılmamalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeyin içine girmesini, bir şeyi içeri sokmayı ve dar bir yere girmeyi aynı çekirdek çevresinde toplar. Gece ile gündüzün birbirine katılması ise bu çekirdeğin yalnızca belirli bir söz bağlamındaki uzantısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek anlam giriş ve içeri sokmadır; yakın çevre, giriş yeri, sık girip çıkma, içe işleyen ağrı ve mala ilişkin özel kullanım bu dalın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın giriş çekirdeğini korur; dar yere girme, yinelenen girişler ve gece ile gündüzün birbirine katılması yalnızca kendi biçim ve söz öbekleri kapsamında ele alınır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyin içine girmesi ya da bir şeyin içeri sokulmasıdır. Dar bir geçide girme ve gece ile gündüz sürelerinin birbirine katılarak artması bu çekirdeğin belirli bağlamlardaki gerçekleşmeleridir.

Belirli bir anlatımda gece ile gündüzün her biri ötekine katılarak süresi artırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar giriş anlamında birleşir; içeri sokma, dar bir yere girme ve gece ile gündüzün birbirine katılması da aynı anlam alanında belirtilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir topluluğun ya da bütünün aslından olmayan fakat ona içerden katılan kişi veya şeyi, ayrıca aileden olmadığı halde güvenilip özel çevreye alınan kişiyi birlikte tanımlar. Dalın toplumsal ve genel unsur okumaları bu ortak dışarıdan içeri alınma ilişkisine dayanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada hareketin kendisi değil, dışarıdan bir bütüne katılmış unsur veya özel çevreye alınmış kişi adlandırılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hem adlaşmış genel unsuru hem de kişi ve topluluk bağlamındaki kalıplaşmış kullanımı ayırır; bunlardan yalın bir giriş fiili türetilmez.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey, aslından olmadığı bir bütünün içine alınmıştır.
Aileden olmayan bir kişi güvenilen özel çevreye ve iç ilişkilere alınabilir.
Bir topluluğa sonradan katılan kişi o topluluktan olmadığı halde onun içinde yer alır.
